thought.text: Ketemu angkanya. Sekarang bandingkan dengan obscurify — apakah dia benar-benar gratis atau cuma lambat tercatat.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && OB=$(grep -oE "sk-obs1_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+" ob_ready.txt | head -1); echo "key: ${OB:0:24}..."; timeout 120 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request
K="$(grep -oE 'sk-obs1_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' ob_ready.txt | head -1)"
import subprocess
K=subprocess.check_output("grep -oE 'sk-obs1_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' ob_ready.txt | head -1",shell=True,text=True).strip()
big="You are Hermes, an AI agent. "*400
for tag,msgs in [("pendek",[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]),
                 ("prompt besar",[{"role":"system","content":big},{"role":"user","content":"hi"}])]:
    b=json.dumps({"model":"deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored","messages":msgs,"max_tokens":200}).encode()
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions",data=b,
        headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {K}","Content-Type":"application/json"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=90) as x: d=json.load(x)
        print(f"{tag:14} usage={d.get('usage')} | extra={ {k:v for k,v in d.items() if k not in ('choices','id','object','created','model','usage')} }")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: print(tag,"HTTP",e.code,e.read().decode()[:150])
PY
